module fluorescence

manifest dbs_extract
manifest extraction_buffer
manifest stop_buffer
manifest calibrant
manifest gaa_reagent
manifest gla_reagent
manifest ids_reagent
manifest gba_reagent
manifest idu_reagent

instructions:

repeat 8 times {
    cal = dispense 3 units of calibrant
    cal_reading = detect fluorescence on cal for 1m
    dispose cal
}

gaa_bg_sample = dispense 1 units of extraction_buffer
gaa_bg_reagent = dispense 1 units of gaa_reagent
gaa_bg_rxn = mix gaa_bg_sample with gaa_bg_reagent for 15s
heat gaa_bg_rxn at 37c for 60m
gaa_bg_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
gaa_bg_final = mix gaa_bg_rxn with gaa_bg_stb for 15s
gaa_background = detect fluorescence on gaa_bg_final for 1m
dispose gaa_bg_final

gla_bg_sample = dispense 1 units of extraction_buffer
gla_bg_reagent = dispense 1 units of gla_reagent
gla_bg_rxn = mix gla_bg_sample with gla_bg_reagent for 15s
heat gla_bg_rxn at 37c for 60m
gla_bg_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
gla_bg_final = mix gla_bg_rxn with gla_bg_stb for 15s
gla_background = detect fluorescence on gla_bg_final for 1m
dispose gla_bg_final

ids_bg_sample = dispense 1 units of extraction_buffer
ids_bg_reagent = dispense 1 units of ids_reagent
ids_bg_rxn = mix ids_bg_sample with ids_bg_reagent for 15s
heat ids_bg_rxn at 37c for 60m
ids_bg_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
ids_bg_final = mix ids_bg_rxn with ids_bg_stb for 15s
ids_background = detect fluorescence on ids_bg_final for 1m
dispose ids_bg_final

gba_bg_sample = dispense 1 units of extraction_buffer
gba_bg_reagent = dispense 1 units of gba_reagent
gba_bg_rxn = mix gba_bg_sample with gba_bg_reagent for 15s
heat gba_bg_rxn at 37c for 60m
gba_bg_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
gba_bg_final = mix gba_bg_rxn with gba_bg_stb for 15s
gba_background = detect fluorescence on gba_bg_final for 1m
dispose gba_bg_final

idu_bg_sample = dispense 1 units of extraction_buffer
idu_bg_reagent = dispense 1 units of idu_reagent
idu_bg_rxn = mix idu_bg_sample with idu_bg_reagent for 15s
heat idu_bg_rxn at 37c for 60m
idu_bg_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
idu_bg_final = mix idu_bg_rxn with idu_bg_stb for 15s
idu_background = detect fluorescence on idu_bg_final for 1m
dispose idu_bg_final

repeat 42 times {

    sample = dispense 1 units of dbs_extract

    gaa_reagent_drop = dispense 1 units of gaa_reagent
    gaa_rxn = mix sample with gaa_reagent_drop for 15s

    gla_reagent_drop = dispense 1 units of gla_reagent
    gla_rxn = mix sample with gla_reagent_drop for 15s

    ids_reagent_drop = dispense 1 units of ids_reagent
    ids_rxn = mix sample with ids_reagent_drop for 15s

    gba_reagent_drop = dispense 1 units of gba_reagent
    gba_rxn = mix sample with gba_reagent_drop for 15s

    idu_reagent_drop = dispense 1 units of idu_reagent
    idu_rxn = mix sample with idu_reagent_drop for 15s

    heat gaa_rxn at 37c for 60m
    heat gla_rxn at 37c for 60m
    heat ids_rxn at 37c for 60m
    heat gba_rxn at 37c for 60m
    heat idu_rxn at 37c for 60m

    gaa_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
    gaa_final = mix gaa_rxn with gaa_stb for 15s
    gaa_activity = detect fluorescence on gaa_final for 1m

    gla_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
    gla_final = mix gla_rxn with gla_stb for 15s
    gla_activity = detect fluorescence on gla_final for 1m

    ids_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
    ids_final = mix ids_rxn with ids_stb for 15s
    ids_activity = detect fluorescence on ids_final for 1m

    gba_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
    gba_final = mix gba_rxn with gba_stb for 15s
    gba_activity = detect fluorescence on gba_final for 1m

    idu_stb = dispense 1 units of stop_buffer
    idu_final = mix idu_rxn with idu_stb for 15s
    idu_activity = detect fluorescence on idu_final for 1m

    if (gaa_activity <= 8) {
        dispose gaa_final
    }

    if (gla_activity <= 6) {
        dispose gla_final
    }

    if (ids_activity <= 6) {
        dispose ids_final
    }

    if (gba_activity <= 7) {
        dispose gba_final
    }

    if (idu_activity <= 5) {
        dispose idu_final
    }

    dispose gaa_final
    dispose gla_final
    dispose ids_final
    dispose gba_final
    dispose idu_final
}

module fluorescence

manifest ecnr2_culture
manifest wash_buffer
manifest resuspension_buffer
manifest pgerc_plasmid
manifest recovery_media
manifest lb_kan_agar

instructions:

cells = dispense 1000 units of ecnr2_culture

repeat 2 times {
    wash = dispense 1000 units of wash_buffer
    cells = mix cells with wash for 90s
    dispose wash
}

resusp = dispense 200 units of resuspension_buffer
cells = mix cells with resusp for 10s

plasmid = dispense 5 units of pgerc_plasmid
celldna = mix cells with plasmid for 10s
heat celldna at 4c for 15m

heat celldna at 23c for 1s

recover = dispense 200 units of recovery_media
outgrowth = mix celldna with recover for 60s
heat outgrowth at 30c for 60m

single_pulse_reading = detect fluorescence on outgrowth for 5m

if (single_pulse_reading <= 80) {
    dispose outgrowth
}

plate = dispense 50 units of lb_kan_agar
colony = mix outgrowth with plate for 10s
dispose colony

cells2 = dispense 1000 units of ecnr2_culture

repeat 2 times {
    wash2 = dispense 1000 units of wash_buffer
    cells2 = mix cells2 with wash2 for 90s
    dispose wash2
}

resusp2 = dispense 200 units of resuspension_buffer
cells2 = mix cells2 with resusp2 for 10s

plasmid2 = dispense 5 units of pgerc_plasmid
celldna2 = mix cells2 with plasmid2 for 10s
heat celldna2 at 4c for 15m

repeat 10 times {
    heat celldna2 at 23c for 1s
}

recover2 = dispense 200 units of recovery_media
outgrowth2 = mix celldna2 with recover2 for 60s
heat outgrowth2 at 30c for 60m

train_pulse_reading = detect fluorescence on outgrowth2 for 5m

if (train_pulse_reading <= 80) {
    dispose outgrowth2
}

plate2 = dispense 50 units of lb_kan_agar
colony2 = mix outgrowth2 with plate2 for 10s
dispose colony2

module fluorescence

manifest Allele1Control
manifest Allele2Control
manifest BothAllelesControl
manifest NoTemplateControl
manifest TaqManMasterMix

instructions:

allele1 = dispense 300 units of Allele1Control
allele2 = dispense 300 units of Allele2Control
both_alleles = dispense 300 units of BothAllelesControl
no_template = dispense 300 units of NoTemplateControl

mastermix1 = dispense 300 units of TaqManMasterMix
mastermix2 = dispense 300 units of TaqManMasterMix
mastermix3 = dispense 300 units of TaqManMasterMix
mastermix4 = dispense 300 units of TaqManMasterMix

droplet1 = mix allele1 with mastermix1 for 5s
droplet2 = mix allele2 with mastermix2 for 5s
droplet3 = mix both_alleles with mastermix3 for 5s
droplet4 = mix no_template with mastermix4 for 5s

repeat 40 times {
    heat droplet1 at 95c for 15s
    heat droplet1 at 60c for 60s
    signal1 = detect fluorescence on droplet1 for 5s

    heat droplet2 at 95c for 15s
    heat droplet2 at 60c for 60s
    signal2 = detect fluorescence on droplet2 for 5s

    heat droplet3 at 95c for 15s
    heat droplet3 at 60c for 60s
    signal3 = detect fluorescence on droplet3 for 5s

    heat droplet4 at 95c for 15s
    heat droplet4 at 60c for 60s
    signal4 = detect fluorescence on droplet4 for 5s
}

dispose droplet1
dispose droplet2
dispose droplet3
dispose droplet4

module fluorescence

manifest DNASample
manifest PCRReagent

instructions:

sample = dispense 30 units of DNASample
reagent = dispense 30 units of PCRReagent
